reviews.text: I made a mobile order for a Oreo blizzard and a brownie blizzard and when I went in the store and waited for my order.  I waited the time but when my order came up the staff was heading to put them in the cooler instead of asking if I was there for a mobile order.  If it wasn’t for the fact that I saw the person holding two blizzards and asked if those were for my name then she would have mad it to the cooler to store them.  They were however courteous and friendly.  The issue that I really have though is that when I got the blizzards home the flavors were wrong.  One was a brownie Oreo hybrid and the other was a chocolate chunk blizzard of some type.  I understand being busy and im patient but when I wait over 10 minutes I would expect it to be right.

reviews.title: Horrible mobile order experience!👎
reviews.text:
I placed a mobile order via my phone & then proceeded to follow the directions provided about having to go inside to pickup my order.. I would have much rather gone through the drive thru, but again the app instructed me to go inside for pickup… Once inside, there was no pickup area or signage on where to pick up the mobile order, thus I was forced to wait in a line that was 8-10 people deep! After 20 mins waiting in the line, I finally got an opportunity to ask where I could pick up my mobile order! I can’t believe what happened next… They couldn’t find my mobile order & kept coming by every few minutes & asking me the same question: “What is the name w/ my order!!! After the 3rd time, they finally came up to the counter w/ my order! Now it was 25 minutes past the time I entered the building (I entered the building when the app instructed me to). By this time, everyone that was in front of me  had literally ordered & got their food/ice cream and left! I couldn’t believe it!! Then after I complained about the wait & screw up on their end, they said next time come through the drive thru for the mobile order & then rushed off! I MOST DEFINITELY WILL NOT BE BACK! 

We have options in town & from now on it’s “Frozen Gold” which is right down the street!

reviews.title: Very bad experience
reviews.text: I have attempted to use my points the last two visits in person to this store but the cashier was unable to figure out how to deduct the points and I paid full price. I decided to go today to use them with a mobile order for a bogo blizzard. It didn’t come off the total. I asked for help at the register and they asked for Gabe the manager. Gabe said there’s nothing he can do short of canceling my order and doing it again. I asked if there was anything else they could do like credit me another blizzard or anything like that. He said no and next time to be sure to add the coupon first. I said I did. And I said I guess I’ll just stop coming in. He walked away and said it’s not our fault but ok. Then they were talking about me to eachother. Then they gave a man in the waiting room coupons because he waited 15 min. I also waited 15 mins. No coupon. No I’m sorry. I won’t be back. Gabe needs a new job. The girl at the register was too scared of Gabe to even get him for help and had to have another worker get him.

reviews.title: Wrong order
reviews.text: Normally I go to get my food but I have nerve issues in my neck that affect my shoulder and arm so I’m unable to drive tonight so I ordered delivery through the Dairy Queen App. I ordered 2 chicken strip basket meals and one of my choice the Parmesan Garlic and my mom ordered the bbq. They sent two meals with bbq. I don’t like bbq much especially sweet and my onion rings even had sauce on them I tasted and it’s not good to me at all and I can’t even eat them. Dairy Queen said to call the delivery service which happens to be with Door Dash and they said that they would not re deliver the correct order. So I ate bread and a few onion rings. Not happy with the service from the store and absolutely not with the delivery service Door Dash. Not to mention I gave a very good tip and paid taxes and delivery fees. 50 some dollars for 2 meals and blizzards that is not okay whatsoever. Do Better Dairy Queen and Door Dash

reviews.title: Richland MS location full of kids (employees) playing
reviews.text: I placed my first app order this evening. Needless to say it was a MAJOR mistake. Should have ordered Sonic instead.  My order was supposed to be ready 12 minutes after placing my order. After making a stop enroute, I arrived in approximately 17 minutes to find my order wasn’t even started. They made our drinks and ice cream first, then we waited 15 minutes for our order. Our order included a chicken strip basket deal with gravy and the upgrade from fries to cheese curds (+$1.99). We were informed they were out of gravy and were just making gravy at 7:15. Also they were out of cheese curds and replaced it with EXTRA onion rings. They were maybe 12 nasty looking onion rings. We also observed the “acting manager” prepare a dipped cone and use his bare hands to “test” the chocolate dip. Fortunately another employee made him throw it away. Another employee was flirting with two young ladies in the drive-thru by giving them free cones meanwhile the “acting manager” tells us we must call customer service to file any complaint. We plan to call them tomorrow and stop by store and discuss their employees attitudes and actions with the general manager.

reviews.title: Poor communication between the app and the store
reviews.text: On December 8, 2025, I placed a order for a medium brownie blizzard should be picked up at the north Durango Dairy Queen location in Las Vegas Nevada. When I arrived to pick up my blizzard, it was 957, the door was already locked, I dialed the number provided to me on the app. I was told by the call taker that the store closed at 9:30, I pointed out to the call taker, but your app says 10 AM. The call taker explain to me that I needed to coordinate with the app side of Dairy Queen to get my refund For my blizzard. Dairy Queen out of the house, failed the Dairy Queen store side of the house in sync of the hours. As a result, I am out seven dollars and change for a brownie blizzard that I did not get and 20 minutes in time and gas spent. Dairy Queen, you should do a better job in communicating in house and their app store hours.
